artifacts.summary: Authored the semantic-element-usage.md standard and installed it as an executed structural self-review gate in the typst implementation agent and skill, plus wiring into the context index, theorem-environments.md, and chapter-template.md.

completion_data.completion_summary: Authored a new semantic-element-usage.md standard for the typst extension covering nine semantic elements (definition, theorem, lemma, corollary, example, proof, remark, rule-block, rule-list), wired it into index-entries.json and README.md, gave theorem-environments.md and chapter-template.md the semantics they lacked, and installed an executed Stage 4C structural self-review plus enforceable MUST NOT items in both typst-implementation-agent.md and skill-typst-implementation/SKILL.md so compile-green stops being the sole verification gate.

memory_candidates.content: When an unenforced checklist line has already failed to change agent behavior once (an agent demonstrably loaded a norm and still violated it), the fix is to route the norm into a verification stage the agent actually executes -- a self-review sub-step with a stated output inside the phase-completion gate (e.g. 'name each file, answer these N questions, state the fix applied') -- plus MUST NOT items, and install it at EVERY authoring path, including any skill-level Stage 5b self-execution fallback that bypasses the agent's own verification. A gate installed only in the agent leaves the fallback path ungated; grep for the skill's self-execution-fallback pattern to confirm there is no third bypassing path before declaring the gate complete.

When writing a usage/semantics standard for a family of related elements (theorem-environment-style semantic markup), structure each element's entry with three fixed labeled parts -- What it is for, Expected density, Legal placement -- and add a Universal Placement Rule stated once and cross-referenced from each entry, rather than restating placement logic per element. Pair the standard with a single Worked Contrast (Correct vs Incorrect) built directly from the real observed defect, and close with a verbatim Self-Review Questions list the enforcing agent/skill can answer as its executed gate output.
